# 3 bedroom bungalow for sale

> 18 Malham Close is an excellently-presented, three-bedroom bungalow providing modern accommodation. The stylish, front-facing Lounge is open to dining space and a well-appointed kitchen; accommodation continuing with three double bedrooms, a versatile office/study, bathroom and conservatory at the rear.

## Fakta
- Typ: bungalow
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 3 bedrooms
- Plocha: 87 m²
- Vlastnictví: Freehold
- Energetická náročnost: D
- Lokalita: Malham Close, Lincoln
- Cena: £315,000
